newsitem.title: UK: UK says picks MTL bid for North East rail as best.
newsitem.headline: UK says picks MTL bid for North East rail as best.

text.p: Britain's rail privatisation agency has picked Liverpool transport group MTL as the preferred bidder for the Regional Railways North East rail franchise, the Office of Passenger Rail Franchising said in a statement issued late on Thursday.

In a statement, Opraf, which has nearly completed the privatisation of all 25 of Britain's passenger train operating companies, said it expected to make a formal announcement of the terms of the franchise award shortly.
In past cases this has followed within weeks.

The Regional Railways North East franchise operates local, urban and inter-urban services across many of the major conurbations of northern England, including centres on Humberside, Merseyside, Tyneside and in Yorkshire.
Last week MTL Trust, which also operates bus services in several parts of Britain, won the Merseyrail Electrics rail franchise, an operator of commuter trains around Liverpool.
